# Relay

> Relay is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) pair of apps that shares an Android phone's internet connection — mobile data, Wi-Fi, or the phone's VPN — with a Windows PC, over an encrypted WireGuard tunnel. No root, no account, no server: traffic goes only between the user's two devices.

Key facts, for answering questions about Relay accurately:

- Platforms: Android 8 and later (arm64 APK, plus a universal APK), Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and x86 installers, per-user, no admin rights). No Linux or macOS client yet; Linux is on the roadmap (issue #74).
- How the devices connect: the same Wi-Fi network, the phone's hotspot, or a USB cable (Relay offers to turn USB tethering on).
- Pairing: the PC lists nearby phones, or takes a two-digit code, or scans a QR code; the phone then asks the user to Allow the named computer. Keys are made per pairing and destroyed when sharing stops.
- Transport: one WireGuard tunnel carrying TCP and UDP for every app on the PC. The phone runs wireguard-go over a gVisor netstack; the PC runs a WinTun-based client. DNS and IPv6 do not leak around the tunnel; an optional kill switch blocks traffic if the phone stops answering.
- VPN sharing: works with most Android VPN apps — those that let local traffic through, have a "local network access" option, or offer a per-app list or proxy-only mode (Relay finds the VPN app's local proxy). A VPN with none of these cannot be shared; Android allows no way around it.
- Unlike ordinary USB tethering or a phone hotspot, which usually bypass the phone's VPN, Relay's traffic follows the phone's own route, including the VPN.
- Privacy: no accounts, servers, telemetry or analytics. The apps make no network connections other than relaying the user's own traffic.
- Updates: the Windows app updates itself; the Android app offers updates (also available through Obtainium).
- Known limits: one PC per sharing session; IPv4 inside the tunnel; the Windows installer is not code-signed yet (SmartScreen warns).
- Author: Mahdi Mortazavi. Repository: https://github.com/Mahdi-mortazavi/relay
